method: Direct reading of pinned Lean definitions and comparison with source_result.tex and check_rotation_certificate.py; no kernel replay.
walk: MSB-first; absent bits are false; false selects cell.1, true selects cell.2; stop at first non-node edge and return consumed depth d.
consume: (P ++ List.replicate d false).take d; therefore execution uses exactly the encountered leaf path.
increment: Fixed-length binary increment; all ones roll over to all zeros; empty word remains empty.
strip: Remove suffix through kth selected bit from the right; exhaustion yields empty; k=0 preserves input.

instruction_branches.CB(k): Registers unchanged; successor breakPath k P; one source step.
instruction_branches.CC(k): Registers unchanged; successor continuePath k P; one source step.

other_registers: Every update preserves R[i] for i different from the selected register.
halts: Exists a finite run reaching AtHalt; step=None alone is not the halting definition.
python_checker: Same increment, strip, break, continue, and zero-padded locate definitions; additional rejection of nonzero unused successor suffixes is the stronger canonicality check stated in source_result.tex.
